def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    remaining_space = bins - item
    valid_bins = remaining_space >= 0
    priority_scores = np.full_like(bins, -np.inf)
    normalized_remaining = remaining_space[valid_bins] / bins[valid_bins]
    priority_scores[valid_bins] = normalized_remaining
    return priority_scores

def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    remaining_space = bins - item
    valid_bins = remaining_space >= 0
    priority_scores = np.full_like(bins, -np.inf)
    # Avoid division by zero or near-zero values
    safe_remaining = np.where(remaining_space < 1e-10, 1e-10, remaining_space)
    priority_scores[valid_bins] = item / safe_remaining[valid_bins]
    return priority_scores
